method: The original supplied JPEG remains the source. Local reconstruction removes baked animated subjects and the redundant distant fire pit. Approved wood, leaves and character artwork are reused. A shared 16-second phase drives seamless tree, fire, particles and character idle animation; the character uses the neutral body and eye-only blink patch without whole-body texture switching.
